summary: Lossy UTF-8 decoding of clamscan stdout corrupts non-ASCII paths; findings for Cyrillic profiles become non-existent paths with no warning
evidence: clamav.rs:80-82 String::from_utf8_lossy; VirusesPage.svelte:65 assessFile(path) caught to null; VirusesPage.svelte:136 #each keyed by path
failure_scenario: Infected C:\\Users\\Слава\\Downloads\\счёт.pdf.exe with clamscan writing ANSI or OEM bytes: path becomes U+FFFD garbage, assessFile silently fails, two such findings can collide as duplicate keys. UNVERIFIED: clamscan stdout encoding on Windows.
